Coram : M.W. Chandwani, J.
Heard.

2. The applicant is seeking anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No. 43/2026, registered with
Police Station Hingna, Nagpur, for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 read with
Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Issue notice to the non-applicant, returnable on 8.4.2026.
4.
Learned APP waives notice on behalf of non-applicant.
5. The contention is that the applicant was only assisting the main accused in selling the plots.
It is submitted that the transaction is civil in nature.
Since, the property was not mutated in the name of the accused, the transaction could not be done.
6. According to the learned APP, accused No.1 is already arrested.

All the transactions were done with M/s. Anusaya Infrastructures which was a proprietary concern in the name of 2 59aba241.2026..odt accused No. 1.
7.
Considering the submissions, perusal of the case diary is necessary which is not available at this juncture.
The State is also yet to file reply.
Therefore, a case is made out for grant of ad interim relief.

Hence, the following order is passed:
i) Pending the application, in the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.
